column1: # OWASP ZAP scan rule configuration for kushnir.cloud / ide.kushnir.cloud
# These rules trigger on expected platform behaviour and are not actionable.

column3: Incomplete or No Cache-Control and Pragma HTTP Header Set (expected on auth flows)
Web Browser XSS Protection Not Enabled (obsolete header, not required)
Cross-Domain JavaScript Source File Inclusion (CDN assets permitted)
X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing (set by Caddy globally; ZAP misses inherited headers)
Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set (applied at Caddy layer before ZAP sees it)
Server Leaks Version Information via Server HTTP Response Header Field
Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set (IDE requires permissive CSP for extensions)
Retrieved from Cache (expected for static assets)
Cookie Without SameSite Attribute (oauth2-proxy cookies use Lax; ZAP scan order mismatch)
CSP Scanner (IDE extension marketplace requires unsafe-eval)
Permissions Policy Header Not Set (not yet implemented, planned)
Timestamp Disclosure - Unix (expected in JSON API responses)
Dangerous JS Functions (required by VS Code extension host)
Absence of Anti-CSRF Tokens (SPA uses JWT/OAuth2, not form-based CSRF)
Incomplete or No Cache-Control on API responses
Cookie Without SameSite on secondary endpoints
